text:
[Council File 26-0088-S2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and ORDINANCES FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to making technical amendments to the legal requirements of covenants required by the United to House LA Program and exempting certain conveyances of real property from the Measure ULA tax.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated October 6, 2026, amending Section 22.618.3 of Article 9, Chapter 24, Division 22 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code to make technical amendments to the legal requirements of covenants required by the United to House LA Program.
2. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated October 13, 2026, amending Section 21.9.14 of Article 1.9 of Chapter II of the Los Angeles Municipal Code to exempt conveyances of real property to two-tiered limited partnerships and limited liability companies whose general partners or managing members are non-profit entities, with a history of affordable housing development and/or affordable housing property management experience, from the Measure ULA tax.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None reported by the City Attorney. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
